name: The History of Richard Raynal, Solitary
name_pt: A História de Richard Raynal, Eremita
desc: Benson's medieval tale of 1906, presented as a recovered manuscript of Sir John, a priest of Edward IV's time: the life of the young hermit Richard Raynal, his visions, his journey to London and his death.
desc_pt: A narrativa medieval de Benson (1906), apresentada como manuscrito recuperado de Sir John, sacerdote do tempo de Eduardo IV: a vida do jovem eremita Richard Raynal, suas visões, sua viagem a Londres e sua morte.
edition: The History of Richard Raynal, Solitary (London: Isbister, 1906), Project Gutenberg #15808, proofread.
